column1: # U.S. populations needing intensive ongoing care
# people. This is the unified-demand side of the labor market: the
# four populations that the paid direct-care + DSP workforce serves
# plus a row for the paid workforce itself.
#   - alz_dementia:     Americans 65+ with Alzheimer's or other
#   - elderly_adl:      Americans 65+ with at least one ADL limitation
#   - idd_adults:       Adults 18+ with intellectual or developmental
#   - disabled_kids:    Children under 18 with significant disability
#   - paid_workforce:   Total paid direct-care workers (HHA + PCA + CNA
# The paid_workforce row is shown for context; it is the supply side
